page.overview:
Who is Thra?

{|cellspacing="1" cellpadding="3" border="0" align="center"

Pages for this subject as it appears in other canons:

Thra was the mother of Piter de Vries, a sickly woman and member of the Olman clan of Gwandali. She lived to a considerable age and adored Piter, her only child, denying him very little. Piter's father's name contained the letters 'ibb' in it. Piter was sold to the Tleilaxu, presumably after the death of Thra.
